g.text: Docker Desktop (Windows): only what Docker's own docs state
Green = stated in Docker's docs. Process names differ between doc pages and versions: verify on yours.
network proxy + port forwarding; host file-
sharing server, runs as the Docker Desktop user
inherits firewall, VPN and HTTP-proxy settings of the user
(only in all-users installs; not used per-user)
Also documented: there is no docker0 on the host; Docker Desktop cannot route traffic to Linux containers (you cannot ping them), and per-container IPs are not reachable
Sources: Docker docs: desktop/features/networking, networking-how-tos, faqs/platform, windows-permission-requirements (read 2026-11-13).
